Pasta in Hongdae: choosing cream, tomato or oil sauce

Looking for pasta in Hongdae? At Hongdae Hwaduk Pizza (홍대화덕피자), compare spicy shrimp cream, tomato with cheese and basil, and shrimp with arugula in an oil-based sauce. Pasta can be the focus of your meal; you can choose it before deciding whether to add pizza.

Choose by sauce and ingredients

To narrow your choice, start with the flavour you want. Gamberi Crema offers rich cream and melted cheese; Pomodoro combines tomato, cheese and basil; Gamberi e Rucola pairs shrimp with arugula in an oil-based sauce. For a spicy tomato base consider Gamberi Piccante, and for shellfish and garlic compare Vongole. Ask the staff before ordering if you have questions about heat or ingredients. Check the current menu and prices on Naver Place.

Getting here from your station

The address is 5 Dongmak-ro 7-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, ground floor. It is about five minutes on foot from Hapjeong Exit 6 or Sangsu Exit 1, and about fifteen minutes from Hongik University Station. If you meet at Hongik University Station, allow time for that walk.

Choosing the pasta shape

With Gamberi Crema, choose hollow penne for short bites that catch the sauce, round spaghetti to twirl around a fork, or flat linguine for a wider ribbon coated in cream sauce. These choices apply to Gamberi Crema. If you like spicy shrimp and mushrooms, compare its cream sauce with Gamberi Piccante’s tomato base.
